name: ZORI
what_it_holds: Small personal repo working with Zillow's own publicly-downloadable Zillow Observed Rent Index (ZORI) CSVs (metro/zip-level, smoothed and seasonally adjusted, monthly, 2015+, direct from zillow.com/research/data). Repo itself likely just re-hosts or notebooks against the same public Zillow file already available directly from Zillow (no scrape needed), so treat the primary source (Zillow Research data page) as the actual holding.
why_useful: ZORI is the standard high-frequency, city-level asking-rent series used to proxy shelter-cost pressure on consumers/hosts; useful as a macro backdrop control for ABNB nights/ADR regressions, but obtainable directly from Zillow without this repo.
size_hint: Zillow's public ZORI CSV, several MB
license: unspecified (data itself is Zillow's, publicly downloadable, non-commercial redistribution terms apply)
themes: Housing and rent inflation nowcasts (Zillow observed rent, Apartment List, Fed rent nowcasts), new-tenant rent index, shelter CPI nowcasting repos
why_all: ZORI is the standard high-frequency, city-level asking-rent series used to proxy shelter-cost pressure on consumers/hosts; useful as a macro backdrop control for ABNB nights/ADR regressions, but obtainable directly from Zillow without this repo.

name: cutterkom/destatiscleanr
what_it_holds: Small R package (14 commits, MIT) that cleans raw downloaded Destatis/GENESIS and Regionalstatistik.de files (German encoding, decimal marks, multi-line headers). README itself says it is largely obsolete since Destatis added direct CSV/API download in 2020. No tourism table specifically named.
why_useful: Marginal — only useful if pulling older-format Destatis exports of German accommodation statistics (Beherbergung im Reiseverkehr / GENESIS table 45412) that predate the API. Flagged mainly because it is the only Destatis-cleaning tool found.
themes: European tourism statistics tooling: Eurostat tour_occ / tour_ce clients, INE Spain Frontur Egatur EOAT tourist-apartment tables, ISTAT, INSEE, Destatis, ONS travel, Portugal INE
why_all: Marginal — only useful if pulling older-format Destatis exports of German accommodation statistics (Beherbergung im Reiseverkehr / GENESIS table 45412) that predate the API. Flagged mainly because it is the only Destatis-cleaning tool found.

name: devashrlucas/OIET_Data_DB

why_useful: Only useful as an alternative access format (queryable DB) if the primary OpportunityInsights/EconomicTracker repo's raw CSVs are hard to work with; adds no new data.
